scenes.text: Developers now type, add a login page to my app, and an AI writes the code, runs it, and even fixes its own bugs. [1] So how do AI coding assistants actually work? [2] Let's find out.

title: AI Coding
Assistants
data.subtitle: How AI reads and writes code

scenes.text: There are three levels of coding help. [1] Autocomplete, which suggests the next few lines as you type. [2] Chat, where you ask questions about code, and get explanations or snippets. [3] And coding agents, which take a whole task, edit many files, and run tests on their own.

Here's how a coding agent works, on a task like, fix the failing login test. [1] It loops, read, edit, and test. [2] It reads the relevant files in your project. [3] It edits the code to fix the bug. [4] It runs the tests, one still fails, so it reads the error and tries again. [5] Now all the tests pass, and it shows you the changes.

log: ✓ all tests pass, show the changes

scenes.text: And the secret ingredient is context. [1] A coding assistant is only as good as what it can see of your project. [2] So it searches your files, [3] reads the error messages, [4] and follows your project's rules and style.

data.definition: The files, errors and rules an assistant reads so its code fits your project.

scenes.text: Here are four words you'll hear. [1] A diff, which shows the exact changes the AI wants to make. [2] Tests, small programs that check the code actually works. [3] A repo, short for repository, your project's folder of code. [4] And review, a human checking the changes before they go live.

So where is it used? [1] In code editors like VS Code, with assistants like GitHub Copilot. [2] In terminal coding agents, like Claude Code. [3] And in app builders, where you describe an app, and get a first version.

data.heading: Where developers use it
items: Describe it, get a first version

scenes.text: Here's a common myth. [1] People think AI coding assistants mean you don't need to learn programming anymore. [2] They make programmers much faster, but you still need to understand the code, to review it, catch mistakes, and keep it secure. Learning the basics matters more than ever.

data.myth: With AI assistants, you don't need to learn programming.
data.fact: They make programmers faster, but you still need to understand, review and secure the code.
data.tip: Learn the basics, then go faster

scenes.text: Quick quiz! What does a coding agent do after its tests fail? [1] Pause and think, and if you get it right, comment below! <pause 3.2> [2] It reads the error, and tries again, until the tests pass!

data.question: When tests fail, a coding agent…
options: Reads the error and tries again

scenes.text: Let's recap. [1] Coding help comes in three levels, autocomplete, chat and agents. [2] Coding agents loop, read, edit and test. [3] Good results depend on context, files, errors and rules. [4] And a human should always review the changes.
